messages:
incbot: INCIDENT  P1: high GPU queue depth in us-west1-primary. autoscaler failing to add nodes. triggered at 2026-10-03T14:05:11Z :rotating_light:
incbot: symptom: request queue > 120k tokens, p99 latency > 3s for text-gen, rate of failed allocations 20/min
sam_oncall: seeing this — dashboards show GPU pool 'primary-us-west1' at 100% reserved, pending pods stuck in Pending state.
alex_sre: @sam_oncall can you paste kubectl describe on one of the pending pods? want to see events (quota/insufficient resources).
sam_oncall: grabbing logs, one sec
sam_oncall: ```kubectl describe pod inference-queue-9f2 -n redwood-serving
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age                 From               Message
  ----     ------            ----                ----               -------
  Normal   Scheduled         10m                 default-scheduler  Successfully assigned ...
  Warning  FailedScheduling  9m (x20 over 10m)  default-scheduler  0/12 nodes are available: 12 Insufficient gpu."
mira_runtime: hmm that looks like cloud provider quota returning insufficient. I'm seeing 429/REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED in cluster autoscaler logs.
tanvi_eng: autoscaler logs? please paste last 50 lines from cluster-autoscaler.
sam_oncall: ```kubectl logs deployment/cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system --tail=50
E1003 14:04:55.123456       1 aws.go:210] DescribeInstances returned error: RequestLimitExceeded: Rate exceeded
I1003 14:05:01.654321       1 scale_up.go:87] scale-up blocked: hit provider API throttle
W1003 14:05:45.000000       1 nodegroups.go:402] nodegroup creation failed: quota exceeded
```
ale x_sre: provider API throttle + soft quota hit. That explains stuck pending. need fast fallback.
mira_runtime: Agree. Routing policy should have spilled to secondary region (us-east1) already — why did traffic not steer?
sam_oncall: checking router logs...looks like steer rule for primary->secondary uses model-compatibility strict match; some requests are pinned to a quantized variant only hosted in primary.
lee_support: Confirmed customer reports: two enterprise tenants experiencing elevated errors and timeouts since 14:03Z. CS is fielding calls.
jon_prod: P0 customers: tenant-betacorp and tenant-highfly. We need to assess impact and message them soon.
tanvi_eng: quick mitigation options: 1) relax routing compatibility to allow compatible-but-not-identical model variants in us-east1 2) enable temporary degraded-mode that serves with shorter context 3) emergency quota request to cloud provider (slow)
mira_runtime: option 1 is fastest if we can accept slight quality variance. need a config toggle in route-service. @tanvi_eng can you flip?
tanvi_eng: on it. will push small config change to route-service: allow_variant_relax=true for customers in overflow policy. prepping deploy.
deploy_bot: starting canary deploy of route-service config rev-20261003-allow-relax to 3/50 pods
tanvi_eng: canary up at 14:12Z, traffic steering for 2% now to us-east1 relaxed variants. monitoring.
lee_support: customers seeing partial recovery? any drop in errors?
sam_oncall: errors dropping ~30% on canary users. queue length overall down 18%. p99 latency trending down slowly.
alex_sre: good. start progressive rollout to 30% then 100% if stable. watch for quality regressions. we have eval hooks for prompt sets.
tanvi_eng: rolling to 30% at 14:15Z.
mira_runtime: running quick evals on representative prompt sets, initial diff shows minor token-level differences but no catastrophic failures. alerting product for signoff.
jon_prod: product aware — ok to proceed but notify enterprise CS for customers with stricter SLOs.
lee_support: emailing tenant-betacorp and tenant-highfly with incident notice and guidance.
incbot: PAGED: oncall escalation to sam_oncall and alex_sre at 14:18Z (ack required)
sam_oncall: acked. will stay on this.
alex_sre: acked.
deploy_bot: rollout progressed to 100% at 14:22Z.
tanvi_eng: traffic now fully steering overflow into us-east1 with relaxed variants. queue metrics back to nominal for now.
mira_runtime: follow-up: we also saw several requests hit a variant mismatch error post-steer for specific tool-calling responses. patching router to map function-call signatures across variants. pushing hotfix.
tanvi_eng: hotfix deployed 14:29Z, observed no further mismatch errors.
lee_support: customers on calls reporting restored behavior, will keep monitoring.
jon_prod: summary for now: mitigation = relaxed variant steering + router mapping hotfix. primary cause = cloud provider quota + API throttling preventing autoscaler from provisioning GPUs. secondary cause = strict routing compatibility that pinned some requests to primary-only variants.
alex_sre: action items (quick):
- open provider support case + request emergency quota increase (sam_oncall)
- implement autoscaler retry/backoff improvements and quota-aware fallback (mira_runtime/tanvi_eng)
- extend route compatibility matrix to include labelled-compatible variants (tanvi_eng)
- run tabletop for cross-region fallback scenarios (eng-sre + product)
(more details in followup)
sam_oncall: opened case with provider at 14:35Z: case# CSP-20261003-433 (incapacity / throttling). added urgent flag.
mira_runtime: logging followup items to postmortem template.
lee_support: sent customers interim update 14:40Z.
jon_prod: incident will remain P1 until steady for 1 hour. will start postmortem after stable.
incbot: Incident status changed to 'mitigated' at 14:50Z by tanvi_eng (note: mitigation = traffic steering + hotfix).
lee_support: final note from CS: clients appreciated quick updates, want SLA credit assessment.
jon_prod: will coordinate SLA impact calc with finance.
alex_sre: adding final ops notes: prioritize implementing provider-throttle detection in autoscaler runbook and add synthetic tests that exercise cross-region steering during high qps.
mira_runtime: will draft postmortem, include timeline, root cause (provider quota + strict route rules), mitigation steps, and long-term fixes.
